image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a used baseball. The ball features a white leather cover that is heavily scuffed and stained with dirt, indicating game use. Distinctive red double-stitching forms the characteristic figure-eight seam pattern. There are visible manufacturer markings in red ink (partially legible as 'OFFICIAL') and blue ink signatures or text on the left side. The lighting highlights the texture of the leather and the raised nature of the stitching.
